object_entity.notes: Bishop of Carthage c. 248–258; major Latin theologian of ecclesiology and sacramental theology; converted c. 246; deeply influenced by Tertullian; key figure in the Novatian controversy (supported Cornelius against Novatian); martyred under Valerian.

evidence.notes: Cyprian is the author of De Lapsis.

passage.excerpt: Paraphrase: How many bishops who ought to have been an encouragement and example to others, despising their divine stewardship, became agents of secular affairs, forsook their thrones, deserted their people, wandered about over foreign provinces, sought the markets for trade. While their brethren were starving in the Church, they wished to have money in abundance.
passage.notes: Bishops who lapsed through worldly accommodation; failure of episcopal leadership during Decian crisis
